say:1:1322123001:1.text: You've returned. How are things at the temple? Is everything okay?
say:1:1322123001:1.source_cn: 你们回来了。修道院的情况……还好吗？

choice_prompt:2:1322123001.text: You've returned. How are things at the temple? Is everything okay?
choice_prompt:2:1322123001.source_cn: 你们回来了。修道院的情况……还好吗？

say:3:1322123002:1.text: I see. I'm sorry you had to go to such lengths for me... I appreciate all you've done.
say:3:1322123002:1.source_cn: 我明白了。很抱歉，让你们为我做了这么多事情……

say:4:1322123003:1.text: In truth, I understand that the people of Whiteridge can't completely trust us.
say:4:1322123003:1.source_cn: 其实我知道，依照现在的情形，白山的民众不可能彻底信任我们。

say:5:1322123004:1.text: Even if the temple recognizes the undead's past as warriors and everyone knows their history, their attacks will continue to terrify the people.
say:5:1322123004:1.source_cn: 哪怕教会认可活死人的身份，哪怕人人都知道他们曾是光荣的...

say:6:1322123005:1.text: In the end, people will still fear us, avoid us, and even doubt the temple's intentions.
say:6:1322123005:1.source_cn: 到最后，人们还是会害怕我们，远离我们，甚至还会质疑教会...

say:7:1322123006:1.text: I didn't want things to turn out like this...
say:7:1322123006:1.source_cn: 我……不想让事情变成这样。

say:8:1322123007:1.text: It seems that we still need to find a way to stop the undead from attacking humans.
say:8:1322123007:1.source_cn: 看来还是得找到让活死人不再攻击人类的方法才行……

say:9:1322123008:1.text: Yes, I've been thinking about this issue for a long time. I believe in order for the undead to rest in peace, we will need the temple's aid.
say:9:1322123008:1.source_cn: 是的。这个问题我反复思考了很久，我认为想要让他们彻底安...

say:11:1322123010:1.text: The Divine Light has a powerful purifying effect on the Graveborn. While it's not as noticeable on Graveborn like me, for the undead who've lost their reason and act on instinct, it's the best solution.
say:11:1322123010:1.source_cn: 圣光对亡灵有着很强的净化作用。虽然在我们这样的亡灵身上...

say:12:1322123011:1.text: But the acolytes don't trust the undead at all. They'll never agree to cooperate with you, Carolina. Ugh, this is such a tough problem. Chippy's head hurts!
say:12:1322123011:1.source_cn: 可是那些修士和修女根本不信任亡灵，肯定不会愿意和卡列琳...

choice_prompt:13:1322123011.text: But the acolytes don't trust the undead at all. They'll never agree to cooperate with you, Carolina. Ugh, this is such a tough problem. Chippy's head hurts!
choice_prompt:13:1322123011.source_cn: 可是那些修士和修女根本不信任亡灵，肯定不会愿意和卡列琳娜合作……啊啊啊，糟糕，这简直就是一个打不开的死结嘛！

say:14:1322123012:1.text: I'll prove my piety and sincerity to the acolytes at the temple, though it might not be the best time to do so just yet...
say:14:1322123012:1.source_cn: 我会向修道院的圣职者展现出我的虔诚和诚意。但……或许不...

say:15:1322123014:1.text: The incident at the funeral has really shaken the acolytes... It's better not to mention it to them at the moment. I won't be visiting the temple anytime soon.
say:15:1322123014:1.source_cn: 葬礼上的意外已经引起了修士和修女的恐慌……现在还是不要...

say:16:1322123015:1.text: In the meantime, I'll go through my family's collection of books. There might be a solution to the undead issue hidden in those ancient tomes.
say:16:1322123015:1.source_cn: 这段时间我会翻翻家族的藏书，或许能从古籍里找到解决活死...

say:18:1322123013:1.text: I'm afraid now is not the best time to do so.
say:18:1322123013:1.source_cn: 现在就去？恐怕不太合适。

choice:13:1:2.text: Go to the temple and talk with them.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 再去修道院和他们聊聊
choice:13:1:2.male: Go to the temple and talk with them.
choice:13:1:2.female: Go to the temple and talk with them.
